blocks.source: Vol IV, Trajectory Planning, § Trajectory Planning Failure Modes and Infeasible Seams
blocks.md: On the mug reach, a replacement trajectory can fail in three distinct regimes: within the candidate itself, along the boundary where it joins the executing motion, or during execution when the environment changes. The point where a failure first manifests dictates which subsystem has the sensory evidence to reject the trajectory, as well as how much time and clearance remain to bring the machine to a safe stop.
